messages.subject: Got slow R code?
parts:
Do you have slow R code?


 

DSI affiliate and graduate student in Statistics, Clark Fitzgerald, is working on making R computing more efficient. If you have some code that meets any of the below criteria and are interested in helping him out (and potentially receiving some feedback/faster code in return!), email him directly at rcfitz...@ucdavis.edu (or tweet @clarkfitzg).

 


Specifically, he’s looking for code that meets any or all of these criteria:


- Process large amounts of data (i.e., 100's of MB's or more)

- Cause memory errors from too large data structures

- Written by R beginners

- Could be parallelized



Thanks!
